episode.title: Ask Ask Ask
episode.lesson: It is brave and smart to ask for help when you need it
episode.lesson_age_appropriate: If you don't know something, you can ask — and that's a superpower.

runtime_math.note: Runtime can expand to 5:30-6:00 by adding 2-3 more dialogue beats or extending participation. This is the minimum viable build.

story_concept.opening_situation: Sunny and Leo are in the backyard. Leo has a broken toy rocket and looks really sad. He doesn't know how to fix it — but he's too shy to ask for help.
story_concept.problem: Leo won't ask for help because he thinks asking means he's not smart.
story_concept.turning_point: Sunny shows Leo that SHE asks for help all the time, and it makes her stronger — not weaker.
story_concept.resolution: Leo raises his hand (or asks Mia) and gets the help he needs. The toy is fixed. Everyone celebrates.
story_concept.lesson_delivered: Asking for help is BRAVE. Asking is how we learn. You can always ask.
story_concept.audience_takeaway: Next time you need help, raise your hand, say the words, and ask.

ACT_2_SETUP: [Sunny faces camera] Hey Crew! It's me, Sunny! And today — something happened that made me think.
[Cut to Leo] Leo has his rocket ship — and it's broken. Oh no!
[Sunny reacts] Leo looks really sad. I wonder... does he need help?
[Sunny turns to Leo] Leo, do you need some help?
[Leo shakes head — too shy to say yes]
[Sunny to camera] Hmm. Sometimes it feels hard to ask for help. But you know what? I know a secret.
[Sunny big smile, taps chin] Asking for help — is actually REALLY brave. Want to hear a song about it?
ACT_4_PARTICIPATION: [Sunny faces camera] Did you hear that? Asking for help is BRAVE!
[Call and response] Can you say it with me? I — can — ask — for — help!
[Clapping beat] Let's clap it out! (clap) Ask! (clap) Ask! (clap) Ask!
[Sunny smiles warmly] And guess what Leo did? He asked Mia for help. And she knew exactly how to fix it!
[Sunny holds up fixed rocket] The rocket is all better. And Leo feels SO proud.
[Direct address] So next time you need help — what do you do? That's right. You ASK.
ACT_4_OUTRO: [Sunny waves from porch] Thank you for watching with me today, Crew!
Remember — asking for help is brave. You are brave.
See you next time! Bye bye!
